# Official Proofreader reference

Generated by `tool/generate_proofreader_reference.py` using Google's 1.1.0 release candidate wheel (`mediapipe-nightly` 1.1.0rc20260925 for macOS arm64, core's `referenceWheels`),
unmodified, with the CPU delegate and Proofread 200M version 1. Google's
releases generate different text, and 1.1.0's options struct gained a
trailing `min_log_severity`, which the recorded ctypes layout shows.
The JSON records model/native checksums, ctypes layouts, completed results,
native correction order, and streaming updates. All sample text was written for
these tests. No correction or prompt is generated by this Dart package.

The model is an optional download, not committed here. It is subject to
[Gemma Terms](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms).

The recorded layouts are the reference wheel's. Google's 1.2.3 libraries, which
the package loads, added `npu_dispatch_library_dir` to the base options, so
every field after them moved by 8 bytes; the tests take those structs from
`test/support/modern_text_reference.dart` (`referenceAbi`), as 1.2.3's ctypes
declare them.
